text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: Game & Watch was a series of handheld electronic games released by Nintendo beginning in 1980. Each unit contained a single built-in game displayed on a dedicated LCD screen and included a digital clock or alarm feature. The series introduced the D-pad controller design and included games such as Ball, Donkey Kong, Mario Bros., Green House, and Octopus. Game & Watch systems became Nintendo's first major success in portable gaming and influenced the development of the Game Boy.
